description: Free, no key: list the tokens an Elysium wallet holds in one call. Returns { wallet, truncated, partial, checked, tokens }: each token has address, symbol, name, balance { raw, decimals }, valueUsd when known, majorAsset, factsStatus and facts { sellTest, hookFee, liquidity, creator, launchpad, template, forcedTransfer } as in trnch_check, read for the 8 largest holdings that are not HYPE, WHYPE or USDC (others: factsStatus over_limit, call trnch_check). At most 100 tokens, largest first. Cached 60 s per wallet. Facts, not a verdict: Trnch runs no rug screen on this chain.
name: trnch_scan_wallet
title: List a wallet's tokens with on-chain facts
